ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Introduction to Natural Language Processing This course will provide an introduction to computational linguistics, from morphology (word formation) and syntax (sentence structure) to semantics (meaning) and natural language processing applications such as parsing, machine translation, generation and dialog systems. Prerequisites: Formal language and automata theory (CS273 or equivalent). Programming experience is necessary for the assignments. Prior exposure to linguistics is not required. This section is for either undergraduate or graduate students.
